static_traits.name: Chen Wei
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with no immediate family members
static_traits.social_status: Social support is weak; only a few acquaintances can be contacted when needed
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no history of psychotherapy; never had similar psychological issues before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to recognize and describe automatic thoughts; calm tone but tense about unfamiliar relationships; fairly cooperative in counseling, able to engage in evidence examination and Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: I have always felt that because of my preferences and past experiences, I am unable to fit in with others, which makes me Feels isolated and sad.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize the persistent sense of Loneliness has affected my daily life and mental health, so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Broke up with ex-boyfriend about a year ago, since then continuously feeling Being rejected and unaccepted, believing oneself unable to fit in with others. To avoid being hurt again, gradually avoiding Social gatherings and new relationship attempts; although trying to distract with hobbies, emotions keep recurring and persisting. Over time, job-seeking Decreased drive, daily routines and self-care habits affected; Living alone and weak social support further worsening Loneliness and sadness.

Tried joining a book club last month, felt judged by others at the scene and left early, never returning. Although someone actively invited participation in conversation there, Anxiety prevented engagement; this experience further Reinforced the belief of 'I am not accepted / not sociable'.

core_beliefs: I will not be accepted by others
I do not belong to any group

special_situations.event: Participating in social activities when having preference differences with others (e.g. different color preferences)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am different from others, it means I will not be accepted
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Leaving early or directly avoiding related social activities to reduce the risk of Being rejected
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never fit in with them

special_situations.event: When joining a book club, notices others looking at oneself or moments of quiet
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others look at me or do not respond with clear enthusiasm, it means they are judging and not welcoming me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing interaction, leaving early, and not participating in the activity again afterwards
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I am strange and do not want me there

special_situations.event: Meeting new people or trying to build new relationships
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If rejected again, I will not be able to bear it, so it is better not to start
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding meeting new friends, staying in familiar environments and a being-alone state

special_situations.event: Recalling the breakup with the ex-boyfriend and the subsequent isolation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have been rejected in the past, it means I am not worthy of acceptance, and it will always be so in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using hobbies to distract oneself but not actively socializing, to reduce the chance of being frustrated again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am always rejected and will never fit in

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and to build stable, intimate connections with others
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected and judged again, worrying that self-worth will be negated
defense_goal: Lowers the risk of being hurt and maintains a sense of safety through distance and avoidance

object_relations.self_representation: A rejected outsider, someone easily judged
A tense and unwelcome participant in social settings
object_relations.object_representation: The group are potential rejecters, friendly on the surface but not accepting inside

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor demands concrete evidence for the belief of 'being judged/not being accepted', or offers a different interpretation (e.g. discussing actual interactions in the reading club)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating the inner fear of being rejected as a real external judgment, believing others (including the group) are judging oneself (transference: projecting self-denial onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keep a gentle tone, led by empathy; first acknowledge the rationality of their feelings, then use curious inquiry to distinguish 'feelings' from 'evidence', invite concrete facts and reality testing, and avoid directly negating their experience.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about whether to return to the book club or try new social opportunities
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Emphasizing 'avoidance is safer' to justify avoidance, viewing withdrawal as a rational choice rather than fear-driven (transference: experiencing the counselor's invitation as a potential risk)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First empathize with their need for safety and control, then gently challenge by proposing small-step alternatives; use concretization, pro-and-con evidence questions and collaborative goal setting, keeping a supportive and encouraging tone.

manifestations: Continued feeling isolated and not accepted after the breakup
Avoiding social gatherings and new relationships
Living alone with weak social support
outcomes: Functioning declines (daily routine and self-care affected)

manifestations: Hobbies can only provide brief distraction but cannot bring connection and fulfillment
outcomes: Decreased quality of life, weakened sense of purpose and direction

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: When narrating the book-club experience, infers others' judgment of her from 'feelings'
Assuming others will not accept oneself, viewing the group as rejecters

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains action impulses originally meant to be expressed outward, turning the energy against the self, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Choosing to leave early or not participate in interactions in social situations
Reducing party attendance and new-relationship attempts, pulling actions back into self-protection

positive_force: Having self-awareness, able to identify and willing to examine automatic thoughts
Willing to try small-step actions (expresses 'I can try')
Can use interests and hobbies for some self-regulation (although the effect is limited)
Can contact a few acquaintances when needed, has certain social support resources
negative_force: Significant cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mind reading and predicting the future
Strong fear of rejection drives social avoidance and alienation
Weak social support and living alone worsen loneliness and sadness
Insufficient job-seeking motivation leads to functional decline
Tending to maintain safety through avoidance and rationalizing it

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (leaving social situations early, staying at home, not attending gatherings or trying new relationships)
antecedent: Meeting new people or trying to build connections
Participating in group activities (e.g. book clubs)
Recalling the breakup and being-rejected experiences
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief of 'I will not be accepted' formed after the breakup, along with cognitive distortions (mind reading, predicting the future, overgeneralization), accompanied by a strong fear of being rejected again.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the discomfort of being rejected and anxiety, maintaining subjective safety and control in the short term.
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent loneliness and sadness, reduced social support, further reinforcing negative beliefs and affecting mental health.

target_behavior.behavior: Low motivation and avoidance in job-seeking
antecedent: Facing job-seeking tasks (preparing resume, applying, interviews)
Thinking about needing to meet new people or be evaluated
target_behavior.core_reason: Isolation and negative emotions lower motivation, while worrying about not being accepted or failing, tending toward catastrophizing and rationalized avoidance.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding failure and negative evaluation, reducing short-term stress and anxiety.
target_behavior.consequence: Continued unemployment, further impaired life functioning and self-care.

target_behavior.behavior: Self-care declines (daily routines and self-care habits are affected)
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative emotions and a sense of meaninglessness lower energy and initiative, making avoidance the primary coping strategy.
target_behavior.function: Temporarily reduces external demands and self-imposed burdens to avoid further emotional fluctuations.
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased quality of life, deteriorating physical and mental state, difficulty recovering active social participation.
